scored_storage.unbounded_threshold_policy: null means no score pruning; finite in-scope scores retained

storage_envelope.selection: finite in-scope margin >= storage_threshold; null means unrestricted finite scores
storage_envelope.decision: minimum of reserve, nominal and all declared WP/absolute variations; automatically expands beyond requested reserve when required

scored_storage.automatic_columns: pair classification, score/model routing, all nominal and declared systematic cuts, and available MC truth QA
limitations: Thresholds below minimum_threshold require re-scoring the original ROOT input.
Storage pruning changes the cutflow input denominator, not accepted nominal/systematic rows.
Counts for invalid_scores and out_of_scope_rows may overlap.

signal.truth_policy: applied by native/previously prepared MC source, not re-evaluated by sampler

background.comparison: mass < low or mass > high; both endpoints excluded

signal.upstream_count_scope: native ROOT truth/kinematic filters precede sampler; unknown for prepared tables
signal.priority_sampling: uniform per-row random priorities; retain max_per_class smallest priorities

mc_reference_audit.bounds: inclusive at both ends; rows removed, surviving values unchanged
mc_reference_audit.efficiency_scope: conditional on the same frozen MC feature ranges applied to all domains
mc_reference_audit.shape_policy: range selection only; no distribution matching, reweighting or Winsorization

reference.source: bounded selected finite-feature reconstructed MC signal sample
reference.group_definition: source file/tree and PV surrogate; not a producer collision ID

limitations: Finite reference quantiles do not guarantee a full-population coverage fraction.
A rectangular feature range does not enforce a joint-density or shape match.
The MC-derived preselection acceptance needs independent MC for a final physical efficiency.

background.upstream_count_scope: native ROOT truth/kinematic filters precede sampler; unknown for prepared tables
background.priority_sampling: uniform per-row random priorities; retain max_per_class smallest priorities
